# Veklom — Governed AI Control Plane

> Veklom builds the governed AI control plane: deterministic authorization,
> audit-grade evidence, and operational control for production AI workloads.
> CO2 Router is our flagship product for environmental authorization.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://veklom.com/): What Veklom does and why governance-first AI control matters.
- [About](https://veklom.com/about): Company background and product brand.
- [Products](https://veklom.com/products): Veklom product portfolio, including CO2 Router.
- [Marketplace](https://veklom.com/marketplace): Policy packs, governance integrations, and CO2 Router add-ons.
- [Pricing](https://veklom.com/pricing): Evaluation, Pro, and Enterprise plans for the control plane.
- [Compliance](https://veklom.com/compliance): SOC 2 status, HIPAA/BAA availability, residency, deployment modes, and audit artifacts.
- [Contact](https://veklom.com/contact): Sales and partnership contact, including trial, demo, and architecture review intents.
